content.text:
Done. Three speaker cards rendered at exact sizes.

**Files produced**
- `square.png` — 1080×1080 (master)
- `landscape.png` — 1920×1080
- `story.png` — 1080×1920

**Source** (kept so the cards can be re-rendered/edited): `card.css` (shared design system), `build.js` (generates `square.html`, `landscape.html`, `story.html`), `audit.js` (layout checker).

**How each size is composed**
- **Square** — vertical editorial stack: logo + wordmark, speaker row (circle portrait left, name/role right), "KEYNOTE" eyebrow with fading rule, big 66px title, divider, then date/venue on the left balanced against the pill button on the right.
- **Landscape** — two columns split by a hairline rule: the talk title at 76px drives the left column with the footer beneath it; the right column is a speaker panel with a 300px portrait, name on one line, role, and a "Keynote Speaker" outline pill.
- **Story** — centered portrait at 340px with name/role under it, left-aligned title block in the lower third, and the footer stacked centered so the CTA sits in the thumb zone.

**Correctness work**
- Font loaded via `@font-face` from `Inter.ttf` with a `100 900` weight range so the variable weights actually render (confirmed `document.fonts.check` is true — no silent fallback to sans-serif).
- The portrait is a fixed-aspect box with `border-radius: 50%` + `object-fit: cover`, so it stays a true circle at every size rather than an ellipse.
- A fit pass runs after `document.fonts.ready` and shrinks the title until it fits its allotted box, so the long title can never be clipped; it was never triggered here (titles kept their intended 66/76/76px and wrapped to 3–4 lines).
- Screenshots gate on a `body.ready` class set after fonts load and layout settles, which avoids capturing an unstyled or mid-layout frame.
- `audit.js` checks every text and graphic element for viewport clipping, horizontal/vertical overflow, pairwise overlap, page scroll, and portrait squareness. First run flagged 4 issues; I fixed the two real ones (landscape name was hyphen-breaking across two lines — widened the panel and set it to one line; square had excess dead space — raised the title size) and the remaining 2–3px flags were line-box rounding, which I resolved properly by adding `0.06em` bottom padding so the boxes fully contain their descenders. Final audit: 0 issues across all three.
